paite: TOUPA Angel khat Gilgal a pan Bokim ah ahohtou hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pawtsak a, 'na pipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka na chiamsa gam ah ka hon pilut a, noute toh ka thukhun ka bohse kei hial ding.
heading: Bokim Ah TOUPA Angel

paite: Hiai gam a tengte toh thu khung kei unla; amaitamte uh hihchipsak un' ka chi hi. Himahleh ka thupiak na zui kei ua, bangziak in ahia hiai na hih uh?
Huaiziak in amaute ka hon delhkhiaksak nawn kei dia, na pang uah lingte ahi zawta ding ua, apathiante uh nou a ding in thang ahi ding uh," ka chi ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel in Israel suan tengteng kiang a hiai thu agenleh mipite aw suah hial in akap uhi.
Huai mun min Bokim asa ua; huai ah TOUPA kiang ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
Joshua in mipite akikhenzaksak nung in Israel suante michih amau tantuam gam chiat luah ding in apaita uhi.
heading: Joshua Sihna

paite: Joshua damsung leh upate Joshua kheng a dam teng, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil thupi ahih tengteng mu mite damsung in mipite'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
Gaash tang mallam pang Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath Heres ah avui uhi.
Huai khang a mi teng leng apipute uh kiang ah apaikhawmta uhi. Amaute nung in TOUPA leh Israelte a dia athilhihte thei lou suan dang ahong omta hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
heading: Israel In TOUPA Biak Atawpsan

paite: TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, pathian dangte, akim ua tengte pathiante azui ua, abia ua, TOUPA ahehsakta uhi.
TOUPA alehngatsan ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, amau dou mite khut ah apia a, amelma uh, akim ua tengte kiang ah akhawng a, amelmate uh azouta kei uhi.
Koipeuh ah hoh mah le uh TOUPA khut atung uah aselam in ake zel a, TOUPA'N akiang ua kichiam a agensa bang in. Huchi in buai namai in abuaita kei uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak a, huaite'n amau dou mite khut a pan ahunkheta hi.
Huchipi in leng avaihawmte uh thu angaikhe kei ua, pathian dangte kiang a angkawm in amaute abe zawta ua, apipute un TOUPA thupiakte pom a azuih uh lampi pen apialsan pah maimah uhi.

TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak chiang in, vaihawmmi kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, vaihawmte damsung in amelmate uh khut a pan ahunkhe zel hi. Amau nuaisiah mite leh hihlungkham mite ziak a amauna un, TOUPA akisiksak hi.

Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, vaihawmmi asih khit chiang in, anungtolh ua, pathian dangte zui a, a-nna uh asep uah apipute uh sang mah in agamta sezaw sem ua; athilhihte uh leh apaupenna uh leng atawpsan tuan kei uhi.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, "Hiai namte'n apipute uh thu ka piak, ka thukhun abohsia ua, ka thu lah angaikhe kei ua;
huaiziak in tuban Joshua sih ma a delhkhiak louh namte ka delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding.
Apipute uh zuih bang a TOUPA dan zuih ding leh ding louh uh Israelte ze-etna ding in amau ka zang ding," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N huai namte delhkhe pah lou in a-omsakta a; Joshua khut ah leng apekhe kei hi.
